request: Initial recovery background
observable_evidence: A brief scan established the notebook population and representative external paths. The inventory was preliminary, but scope should have been established before starting broad exploration.
better_approach: State the proposed first inspection and let the user finish establishing scope.

request: Pause while manuscript scope is explained
observable_evidence: Stopped and acknowledged that only a subset would be prioritized.
better_approach: Keep the acknowledgement short; do not continue independent broad analysis after an explicit pause.

request: zsh logical OR question
observable_evidence: Provided valid OR syntax but incorrectly said grouped alternation requires extended_glob. Brace expansion also has unmatched-pattern and duplicate-match behavior that was omitted.
better_approach: Recommend ls -d -- *(this|that)*. Grouped alternation works without extended_glob. Mention (N) only if the user wants unmatched patterns ignored.

request: Nine manuscript directories supplied
observable_evidence: Inspected the named notebooks and shared readers, found direct resource paths and generated-input dependencies, and checked the expected resource directory.
better_approach: Keep the manuscript subset as an explicit scope separate from whole-repository coverage.

request: Whether to download the whole Dropbox backup
observable_evidence: Correctly proposed selective recovery, but discussed fallbacks before discovering whether a Dropbox integration was available.
better_approach: Check connected tools and plugin discovery first, then recommend the smallest necessary download.

request: Whether a Dropbox plugin is needed
observable_evidence: Searched the plugin directory, found an eligible Dropbox plugin, and distinguished suggesting it from actually installing or connecting it.
better_approach: A short factual response is sufficient; tool discovery supplies the necessary evidence.

request: Where to install the Dropbox plugin
observable_evidence: Checked official documentation and gave concrete CLI installation steps without claiming installation occurred.
better_approach: Prefer one supported route with a source; avoid broad setup advice.

request: Access to the supplied Dropbox folder
observable_evidence: Resolved the shared link, browsed QPS and in vivo, and found five exact-name manuscript candidates without downloading or altering files.
better_approach: Continue distinguishing filename matches from content validation.

request: When and how the notebook inspection happened
observable_evidence: Explained the two inspection passes and acknowledged static inspection rather than execution or exhaustive runtime validation.
better_approach: Lead with what was inspected and what has not been established.

request: Whether resources had been checked
observable_evidence: Named the actual inspected resources directory and admitted that the whole resources tree had not yet been searched.
better_approach: Maintain this level of specificity in status reports.

request: Request to review all notebooks
observable_evidence: Clarified all 83 versus the nine manuscript directories and prepared a scoped static-audit plan. Planning mode constrained execution, but the transition was not always obvious to the user.
better_approach: State clearly whether the current result is a plan, an audit, a download, or a completed restoration.

request: Implement the full audit
observable_evidence: Produced inventories and coverage, handled Python, R and shell references, searched local candidates and Dropbox, and validated coverage. Several iterations corrected checkpoint paths, false positives and unsupported operations. The audit remains conservative static analysis.
better_approach: Keep a clearly named historical snapshot plus a current recovery view; do not describe unresolved references as proven physical files.

request: Whether the user can ask another question during work
observable_evidence: Acknowledged steering without dropping the running audit.
better_approach: One sentence is sufficient.

request: First proposal to use tldraw for dependencies
observable_evidence: Read the tldraw skill and discovered boards without editing one. Proposed starting with the manuscript subset even though the user was moving toward a full map.
better_approach: Confirm the requested map scope and destination; avoid starting design implementation before the user finishes the brief.

request: Clarification to plan first and make a social post later
observable_evidence: Respected the pause on drawing and proposed detailed and simplified views. The question contrasting research recovery with AI workflow created unnecessary friction because both were part of the intended story.
better_approach: Reflect the combined goal: demonstrate AI-assisted recovery, with the detailed map as working evidence.

request: Post should show AI plus tldraw for data recovery
observable_evidence: Integrated the clarification into a coherent recovery workflow.
better_approach: Acknowledge the corrected intent without asking another optional framing question.

request: Detailed three-column map and recovery sources
observable_evidence: Captured notebook/input/source structure and investigated source URLs. No canvas was created, but execution-oriented wording could imply more progress than had occurred.
better_approach: Explicitly distinguish agreed design from a created board, and direct matches from reconstruction precursors.

request: Whether the original audit was finished
observable_evidence: Reported a completed static audit and separated it from notebook execution and workbook-content validation.
better_approach: Use precise counters and link the saved artifacts.

request: Pull up the audit summary
observable_evidence: Summarized missing paths, unresolved references and Dropbox matches.
better_approach: Keep raw source files distinct from generated results and caches.

request: Give the audit files
observable_evidence: Provided the actual artifact paths, but the interaction was too elaborate for a user trying to locate a directory. Some realtime intermediary wording referred to a shared timeline.
better_approach: Give the directory first, then the two primary artifacts; expand only on request.

request: Just give the path
observable_evidence: Returned only the requested absolute directory.
better_approach: This was an appropriate low-latency response; medium-level analysis added no necessary value.

request: Report moved to vault; CO28154 raw precursor identified
observable_evidence: Verified the symlink, found the raw workbook locally, inspected sheet names, and recognized reconstruction rather than direct filename recovery.
better_approach: Make raw-to-clean provenance a first-class candidate type in later audit revisions.

request: Exactly: confirm the reconstruction framing
observable_evidence: Accepted the correction without taking new actions.
better_approach: Keep confirmation minimal.

request: First Graphviz timeline request
observable_evidence: Checked Graphviz, dates, output types and producer links, then wrote a feasible plan. Planning mode prevented creation, but a long plan was less useful than a brief statement of what could be generated.
better_approach: Explain the mode constraint early and keep the plan proportional to the requested first draft.

request: Sigh following the Graphviz plan
observable_evidence: Explained that implementation mode was required, but only after visible frustration.
better_approach: Do not treat a nonverbal transcript as a new technical task; give a concise status if necessary.

request: Anonymous unlabeled graph clarification
observable_evidence: Revised the complete specification to identical unlabeled nodes, three rows and a separate identity mapping.
better_approach: Carry the no-label constraint explicitly into rendering checks.

request: Implement anonymous Graphviz graph
observable_evidence: Created a reusable DOT/SVG pipeline, represented every notebook, deduplicated file nodes, preserved output-to-consumer links, corrected compressed spacing and visually inspected the render. Unresolved references were documented as placeholders.
better_approach: Keep those placeholders visible in metadata and avoid implying every node is a confirmed distinct file.

request: Suggest gitignore changes
observable_evidence: Inspected actual untracked sizes and existing rules, recommended targeted exclusions, and kept useful audit data. Correctly noted that ignoring tracked files does not untrack them.
better_approach: Retain the distinction between suggestion and execution.

request: Apply gitignore changes
observable_evidence: Applied the requested lines and checked representative ignore matches.
better_approach: A narrow patch and a focused check are sufficient.

request: Difference between ! commands and an ordinary shell
observable_evidence: Explained transcript visibility, environment and permissions, but did not initially target the user's real question about who formulates the command and how it affects context.
better_approach: Lead with command authorship and session context, then discuss execution environment only if relevant.

request: Clarification about ! command authorship and context
observable_evidence: Correctly explained that the user supplies the command and its result enters later model context.
better_approach: Do not infer measured billing or internal reasoning usage from the transcript alone.

request: Graph v1: date scale, timeline, black edges and labels
observable_evidence: Implemented pinned date coordinates, a 5x timeline, matching fonts and letter-width sizing; checked rendered geometry and text rather than only source settings.
better_approach: This is a suitable use of medium effort because several geometric constraints interact.

request: Graph v2: hollow nodes and missing-file coloring
observable_evidence: Used actual rendered radii, checked local availability, kept unknown paths distinct from confirmed missing files, and verified edge and notebook color rules.
better_approach: Continue defining the semantics of black/unknown separately from verified availability.

request: Graph v3: white notebook fills and red outgoing edges
observable_evidence: Made the narrow requested modification, preserved geometry, and checked fills and edge colors.
better_approach: Reuse prior graph metadata and validation rather than reopening the entire design.

request: Interactive hover tooltips and social posting
observable_evidence: Proposed SVG tooltips using the existing identity mapping, with a hosted page for richer interaction and static previews on social feeds. Checked relevant documentation.
better_approach: A full visualization framework is unnecessary for basic filename hover.

request: Where the interactive page could be hosted
observable_evidence: Recommended GitHub Pages based on the existing repository and clarified that nothing had been published.
better_approach: Treat hosting as a proposal until publishing is authorized and performed.

request: Restore manuscript data: what information is needed
observable_evidence: Investigated cleaning evidence but answered the cleaning question before the user's immediate question about general Dropbox-to-path restoration.
better_approach: Say the restoration has sufficient inputs, then discuss cleaning separately.

request: User separates restoration and independent cleaning assessments
observable_evidence: Accepted the two-step workflow and the independent raw/cleaned review requirement.
better_approach: Keep the independence requirement in the task state until the comparison is finished.

request: Has recovery already happened?
observable_evidence: Truthfully clarified that no files had been restored. The need to ask showed that prior execution-oriented updates and planning constraints had not made the state clear enough.
better_approach: Use explicit state labels in updates: planned, staged, validated, installed.

request: What review or plan can be inspected?
observable_evidence: Pointed to saved audit artifacts and admitted that the restoration plan was not yet a separate saved document.
better_approach: Do not imply that a conversational plan already exists as a file.

request: Execute the restoration plan
observable_evidence: Downloaded five exact candidates, checked Dropbox hashes, staged before installation, used no-overwrite semantics, obtained required filesystem access and saved provenance. Initially treated cm headers as a validation failure before establishing that the rename list was optional for those metrics.
better_approach: Separate file integrity, required schema checks and nonblocking compatibility notes from the start.

request: Which workbook and rename list have the unit mismatch?
observable_evidence: Located exact sheet headers, notebook cell and helper lines, and clarified that renaming is not conversion.
better_approach: Keep the explanation at the concrete header-to-code level.

request: Patch the notebook to recognize centimeters
observable_evidence: Made a one-line source change, preserved data values and validated notebook JSON.
better_approach: Low effort would plausibly suffice; no broad refactor or workbook edit was needed.

request: Infer CO28152 rules independently, then compare human notes
observable_evidence: Saved an independent assessment before opening the human notes, compared 5,945 cells, reconstructed headers and merges, preserved seven blanks, and reconciled all four human rules. A failed exact cross-sheet key assertion revealed a real numeric/text ID distinction and was corrected without modifying data.
better_approach: This is the best example of effort buying scientific reliability rather than response length.

request: Clean and install CO28154
observable_evidence: Preserved four different sheet populations, lowercase summary labels, source precision and all 10,374 retained animal cells; matched the saved covariate order and tested the actual reader. Tool initialization stalled; fallback authoring initially copied incompatible cross-workbook style IDs and failed before being fixed.
better_approach: Use the bundled executable from the outset, bound initialization retries, and copy style components across workbooks rather than raw style IDs. Chain build and verification only after successful preceding steps.

request: Are all manuscript source inputs available now?
observable_evidence: Rechecked exact filesystem paths and correctly reported six present and five remaining source paths, separately from generated/cache gaps.
better_approach: Use the live filesystem instead of repeating historical audit counts.

request: Add recovered versus still-missing CSV filters
observable_evidence: Added current recovery status and provenance without destroying original observations, refreshed notebook counts, verified recovery hashes and confirmed every original CSV row and field was preserved.
better_approach: Keep historical and live state separate; ensure future refresh procedures do not silently discard the added columns.
